summary: In Episode 9 of Tafseer Surat Al-Anbiya, Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses verses from Chapter 21 of the Quran, focusing on the concept of divine authority and monotheism. The lecture explains that Allah cannot be questioned or required to justify His actions, as He alone possesses absolute authority. The sheikh addresses the rhetorical question of why people worship false gods besides Allah, presenting both logical and revelatory evidence for monotheism. He discusses how the logical impossibility of multiple omnipotent creators proves the necessity of one God, and references scriptural evidence from previous revelations. The lecture then turns to the refutation of pagan Arab beliefs, specifically addressing the Quraish claim that angels are the daughters of Allah, which the Quran explicitly denies.
